Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** A SLIGHT SHEEN ON THE SURFACE OF WAXDALE CREEK WAS IDENTIFIED NEAR WAXDALE OUTFALL #3 (BUILDING 50/51). WAXDALE'S INTERNAL EMERGENCY RESPONSE BRIGADE WAS PRESENT AND DEPLOYED ABSORBENT MATERIALS PRIOR TO RELEASE AS A PRECAUTION WHEN A REPAIRED PIECE OF EQUIPMENT WAS STARTED UP. THE VISUAL OBSERVATIONS SHOW THE BOOM IS HOLDING A SMALL PLUMB OF SURFACE SHEEN. THE QUANTITY IS UNDETERMINED AND CONSIDERED AGAIN TO BE A VERY SMALL AMOUNT. THERE IS NO VISUAL EVIDENCE OF DOWNSTREAM IMPACTS.

properties.content:
Report Details

Nearest City: Dexter, MI
Location: WYLIE MIDDLE SCHOOL COMMUNITY POOL 3060 KENSINGTON STREET
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: SODIUM THIOSULFATE PENTAHYDRATE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: DEXTER COMMUNITY SCHOOLS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.329268, -83.882983 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 5 gallons
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** THE DEXTER AREA FIRE DEPARTMENT (DAFD) WAS CALLED TO A HAZMAT INCIDENT AT THE WYLIE MIDDLE SCHOOL COMMUNITY POOL LOCATED AT 3060 KENSINGTON STREET IN DEXTER, MICHIGAN. IN THE SWIMMING POOL AREA, THE SMALLER POOL HAD A PUMP MALFUNCTION WHICH ALLOWED SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE AT 12.5% TO CONTINUE TO PUMP INTO THE POOL. AS THE RESIDUAL CHLORINE LEVELS WERE HIGHER THAN NORMAL, THE CUSTODIAN ATTEMPTED TO CORRECT THE RESIDUAL CHLORINE LEVEL WITH SODIUM THIOSULFATE. A REACTION OCCURRED WHICH RELEASED IRRITATING GAS. THE DAFD RESPONDED TO APPROXIMATELY 150 PEOPLE EVACUATED FROM THE POOL AREA. HURON VALLEY AMBULANCE EVALUATED ANY PATIENTS COMPLAINING OF DIFFICULTY BREATHING OR OCULAR IRRITATION. CHEMICALS USED WERE “HIGH-PO-CHLOR BRAND SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE LIQUID CONCENTRATION 12.5% AND SODIUM THIOSULFATE PENTAHYDRATE” AT 11:00 AM RESIDUAL CHLORINE READING IN SMALL POOL WAS GREATER THAN 10 PPM. OUR COUNTY HAZMAT TEAM ARRIVED AT 11:39 AM. AT 12:26 PM AIR SAMPLE BY DRAGER TUBE INDICATED 0.2 PPM OF CHLORINE. INCIDENT TURNED OVER TO DEXTER COMMUNITY SCHOOLS AT 12:30 PM.
